# GTK shell protocol

Unmodified XML and accompanying COPYING from GTK commit
`b3d08d3e60136da2522de3313cf4479e1d6fe20f`.
XML SHA-256 `cc2717ba21182f637843e593f7aa2e543c1d6554a886053f400d81906967659d`;
COPYING SHA-256 `b7993225104d90ddd8024fd838faf300bea5e83d91203eab98e29512acebd69c`.
These retain upstream licensing. Tarot generates Rust bindings and exposes
version 4; this is not a claim to implement newer GTK requests.

[Upstream protocol](https://github.com/GNOME/gtk/blob/b3d08d3e60136da2522de3313cf4479e1d6fe20f/gdk/wayland/protocol/gtk-shell.xml)
· [COPYING](https://github.com/GNOME/gtk/blob/b3d08d3e60136da2522de3313cf4479e1d6fe20f/COPYING).
